name: Hannah
source:
Favorite undies: Lace
Favorite season: Spring
Hobby: Working
Favorite color: Red

Hannah has worked at the store since she was eighteen, hoping to one day use her experience to get a management position herself, always a little unsure about herself and what to try.

With the original manager's sudden disappearance, Hannah finally has a chance to prove herself as the new manager at the Negligee store.

[Taken from [url=http://i.imgur.com/IlBoRvW.png]Character Bio Sheet[/url]]
